channel.title: Myro Weekly
channel.description: Free weekly hiring intelligence. Real skill demand data from thousands of live job postings.

item.title: Only 8% of India's open jobs will hire a fresher
item.description: Only 7.9% of India's open roles will take a fresher, and technology is the worst at 1.7%. Here is where the fresher jobs actually sit, plus a free skill check.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: Two Industries Are Quietly Hiring 5× Harder Than Tech. Neither Is the One You're Watching.
item.description: Everyone watches tech hiring. The jobs are somewhere else. In the second week of July 2026, consulting and BFSI carried 62% of all active postings — more than five times technology. And the AI roles you imagine sit at product companies are actually concentrated inside the consulting giants.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: Bengaluru Builds, Mumbai Banks, Hyderabad Ships. Your City Is Quietly Picking Your Skills.
item.description: Same country, four different job markets. In the second week of July 2026, Bengaluru's postings ask for AI and platform engineering, Mumbai's for banking and regulation, Hyderabad's for delivery and QA, and Delhi's for AI consulting. Where you live is quietly choosing your skills — and AI is the one that travels everywhere.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: Agentic AI Hit 843 Job Posts in the Second Week of July 2026. We Checked What's Real.
item.description: In the second week of July 2026, 843 India postings named 'Agentic AI' as a required skill — up from a handful in spring. But 499 came from a single company. Before you panic that you're behind, sit down. We looked properly. The real number is 344, spread across 73 employers and 8 industries.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: From DevOps to Loop Engineering: A Four-Skill Jump
item.description: DevOps and SRE appear in 375 India postings; loop engineering in zero. The gap is four skills, not a career change. A free ladder from SRE to AI-agent reliability.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: Loop Engineering: The Skill With Zero Job Titles in 2026
item.description: Zero postings say 'loop engineering.' But 213 say 'Generative AI Agents' and 30 say 'AI Agent Monitoring.' The job is hiring — free 90-day plan to do it before the title catches up.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: India's Hiring Supermajority Isn't Tech in 2026
item.description: In 38,138 active India roles, BFSI and consulting hold 18,698 — nearly 3× pure tech. A free June 2026 breakdown, and the one employer that tops them all.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: One in Four India Roles Is in Bengaluru 2026
item.description: Bengaluru holds 8,991 of 34,959 India roles in our June 2026 data — one in four. See the top employers and a free skill-gap analysis.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: Banks Out-Hire Big Tech in India 2026
item.description: In 35,000 India roles, BFSI posted 8,182 — more than double the technology sector. A free June 2026 hiring breakdown with the top banks.
item.author: Shivam Pathak

item.title: Siemens Hiring India 2026: 1,461 Roles
item.description: A June 2026 snapshot of 1,461 active Siemens India roles — more than Wipro or Accenture in our dataset. Free skill-gap analysis inside.

item.title: Hiring Map May 2026: 5 Surprises in 30,000+ India Jobs
item.description: After tracking more than 30,000 jobs from MNC career pages, the data tells a different story. Pune outranks Hyderabad. Two pharma companies post 1,000 roles. 'Collaboration' is listed 229 times and required 3. Free skill-gap analysis inside.

item.title: AI Hiring April 2026: Banks Beat Big Tech
